name: Extended-Exhale Breathing

instructions.description: Settle into a comfortable seated or lying position.
Exhale smoothly for a slightly longer count than the inhale.
Return to natural breathing if light-headed or uncomfortable.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record a comfortable breathing rate without prescribing a universal norm.

variations.variationDescription: Extended-Exhale Breathing — Shorter Practice Version: Use a shorter comfortable practice period while preserving relaxed breathing.

commentsNotes: Make the exhale only slightly longer than the inhale and remain comfortable.
